citations.what: WPA/Lord numbered-list entries (every entry row for each id) for the gap ids whose WPA citations include a Civil Service Commission annual report (CSR) or Act and Rules (CSA) volume
citations.id_selection: research/pre-1937-sources/GAP_ROUTES.csv rows with wpa_route=csc_report (branch app-executive-orders, uncommitted 2026-10-19)
citations.gap_list: jobs/app-executive-orders/data/PRIORITY.txt minus 30 ids in HathiTrust public volumes = research/pre-1937-sources/PROQUEST_RESIDUE.txt
citations.wpa_key: WPA list p. xii: CSR = Annual report of the United States Civil Service Commission; CSA = Civil Service Act and Rules, Executive Orders and Regulations. Arabic numerals before the abbreviation give the date of the volume; the number after it is the page.
